summary: Frontend smoke regression for Capacitor native shell integration on web build. Login, bottom nav, settings (biometric row), QR, card transfer, and chats routes verified. No Capacitor/@exxili/@aparajita module errors; no uncaught exceptions on web.

issues: React hydration warning: <option>/<select> wrapped by visual-editor <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> instrumentation at translate-language-select (SettingsPage line 417-418). Not caused by Capacitor changes; appears to be pre-existing visual-editor side-effect but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage.jsx line 417: <select>/<option> are rendered inside a visual-editor-injected <span style={display:contents}> causing React hydration warnings. Consider marking the translate-language select as x-excluded or wrapping differently to silence the warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified Capacitor integration did not regress web build. Checked at viewport 390x844: (1) login lands on /my-profile with 0 pageerrors; (2) no console errors mentioning capacitor/exxili/aparajita/module-not-found/undefined-plugin; (3) /settings shows data-testid=setting-biometric-lock with toggle (data-testid=toggle-biometric-lock) correctly disabled and subtitle 'Disponible en la app de BRUNO para iPhone y Android'; both 'Cambiar contrasena' and 'Usuarios bloqueados' rows still present; (4) QR page /cards/<id>/qr renders QR (14 img/canvas elements including the QR) and 'Descargar QR' button; (5) /cards/<id>/transfer renders Transfer screen with NFC-not-available fallback message, no errors; (6) /chats redirects to /reels (expected behavior; not a regression); (7) MobileBottomNav uses data-testid='mobile-bottom-nav' (not individual bottom-nav-<tab> ids) - 8 nav items confirmed rendered. Only noise in console: pre-existing WebSocket chat reconnect warnings and visual-editor-induced hydration warnings on <select>/<option>. No regressions from craco.config.js webpack rule changes or native/* additions.
